headline: NZ median value up 0.1% April, Auckland still declining
caption: Fresh April data shows NZ's property market is stabilising, but Auckland continues to trend backwards. If you're an East Auckland homeowner or seller thinking about your next move, understanding these local trends is crucial—this is the market reality we're working with right now. Let's chat about what it means for your situation.
